label: Structured W256 causal self-attention - 2x1s input / 2x1s output x59 - one-pass hindsight - variance +0.01 only at next-1s reconstruction corr >= 2^(-1/3600) - pure Gaussian validation - 256k - equal batch 10240 - EMA4

architecture.numberedLayerSharing: each parenthesized number is one exact shared module reused at every matching block; layers other than 8 remain GNGLUs, while layer 8 is one shared causal self-attention module
architecture.initialState: the first observed W embedding seeds M and P with two unnumbered GNGLUs; shared layer 3 produces F and shared layer 4 produces PF
architecture.outputState: shared layer 7 maps PF to NF; shared layer 8 causally self-attends over the generated NF-state prefix to emit expected W; shared layer 2 decodes W to the complete next-second O-feature state; add shared hindsight projection to NF before layer 8 and before recurrent propagation
architecture.latentSemantics: P, F, PF, and NF remain unconstrained latent embeddings in this experiment; no probability decoder or density loss is imposed

hindsightConditioning.source: clean standardized future target features during training only
hindsightConditioning.projection: one shared GNGLU (59 noisy features + scalar noise variance) to NF256, added after layer 7 at the matching output step

loss.description: mean MSE over both predicted output steps and all 59 feature channels after per-feature training-split standardization

hindsightNoiseSchedule.advance: check once after each complete epoch; if threshold met, increment variance once for the next epoch, capped at 1; otherwise hold indefinitely within the run epoch budget
hindsightNoiseSchedule.prediction: clean standardized features in one forward pass; no iterative denoising

sampling.description: original dense chronological clean-origin dataset with exact-zero next-return targets excluded
sampling.comparisonControl: same architecture, dataset, loss, optimizer and batch as predecessorPlanId, but start fresh and use a correlation-gated variance curriculum instead of the epoch-based ramp

evaluation.headline: step-1 next completed 1s signed log return
evaluation.checkpointSelection: pure-noise validation step-1 next-return MSE and correlation; test never selects
evaluation.hindsight: all forecast evaluations use variance 1 and fixed split-specific Gaussian streams independent of targets. A separately labeled target-assisted training-only reconstruction probe controls the curriculum and never selects forecast checkpoints.

alignment.input: two consecutive timeline rows ending at each clean example origin
alignment.target: the two complete chronological timeline rows at origin+1 and origin+2
alignment.futureExtension: K1 uses consecutive rows ending at origin; K2 uses consecutive rows starting at origin+1
alignment.attentionCausality: output step s attends only to generated NF states at output steps <= s
alignment.hindsight: training side token s corrupts target row origin+s+1; held-out targets never create side inputs. Each output can use its own and previous noisy tokens, never later tokens.
